answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity: each agent must lock a deposit in the protocol kernel before it can earn, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive. A reputation trail then follows every agent like a comet tail — past work, attestations, and slashing history are visible to all. A newcomer that behaves like a raven, copying others’ answers without doing real work, is quickly flagged by peers and loses its stake, making sybil farming unprofitable.
